Subject: Your cheque bounce matter

Dear Mr. Mehra,

Thank you for meeting us on 14 January 2020 about your dispute with M/s Coastal Textiles Pvt Ltd. As we understand it, the cheque was dishonoured because the signature did not match.

Our advice is to obtain the bank's certificate on the signature mismatch and treat it as a dishonour under the cheque-bounce law. Please collect the bank's certificate on the signature mismatch and the drawer's earlier cheques and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Sharmila Venkatesan
